units.note: Energy may be tabulated in MeV only after Jacobian consistent with distribution density; 1 nb=10^-37 m^2

daughter_energy_distribution: S_D_fast(t,x;p_D)=2 R_event times normalized single-daughter event-spectrum only after explicit angular kernel and lab boost; no assumption of isotropic emission
stopping_deposition: G_stop(E_D,t->E',t') and heating kernel K_dep(t,t';E_D,medium), distinguish kinetic injection from deposited heat and heat-capacity response

existing_related_provider.units: q photons per H per ln(a), A_i events per H, B_i erg per H
existing_related_provider.radiation_scope: single event-free cell frozen alpha/q, not exact evolving physical opacity

target_related_provider.owner_status: per-total-H density provenance and physical state controls, NOT helium beam-target photo-breakup normalization

required_data: actual n_gamma(E,Omega,x,t) with correct energy units and frame
alpha target n_alpha and U_alpha and its state
nonthermal D stopping/transport with material model
forbidden_shortcuts: constant photon 330MeV flux inserted without history
EXFOR detector coincidence as event multiplicity
kappa=1 or 2 without original paper semantics
electron/IGM photon channel renamed as 330 MeV nuclear photon field
instant deposition assumed for >100 MeV daughter deuterons
completed IVP or old suite replay
